name: NATURALCORDE -Aiyoku no Iro ni Somerarete, Watashi wa Arugamama no Jibun ni Naru-
original_name: NATURALCORDE -愛欲の色に染められて、私はあるがままの自分になる-
source:
KI-SofTWarE's new brand, "Platina Light", is pleased to present its very first NTR adventure!
It's a short and simple nukige that utilizes the EXperientiaL CG VieW system.

When a younger guy meets a serious but kind girl virgin, she's sure to get corrupted by his shota charms!
At home, at school, outside, and more! There are tons of situations and outfits to enjoy, as well.
Eventually, spending every day mired in the pleasures of the flesh starts to change her...

"Big sis, no matter what, I'm going to make you mine and mine alone..."

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ309761.html/?unique_op=af&locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
KI-SofTWarE的新品牌“Platina Light”很高兴推出其首个NTR冒险游戏！
这是一个简短而简单的Nukige，利用EXperientiaL CG View系统。

当一个年轻人遇到一个认真但善良的处女时，她肯定会被他的正太魅力所腐蚀！
在家里、在学校、在外面等等！还有大量场景和服装可供享受。
最终，每天沉浸在肉体的快乐中开始改变她……

“姐姐，无论如何，我都要让你成为我的，我一个人的……”
